core_obligations: Compute the higher direct images (proof lines 14212-14218): for the morphism of sites epsilon : S_etale -> S_Zar, the Zariski sheaf R^p epsilon_*F is the sheafification of U |-> H^p_etale(U, F), so its stalk at x is the colimit of these groups over the neighbourhoods of x.
Identify the stalk (proof lines 14219-14222): the colimit lemma rewrites that stalk as H^p_etale(Spec(O_{X,x}), G_x) for G_x the pullback of F to the local scheme.

Conclude (proof lines 14223-14225): since the local rings are strictly henselian the vanishing lemma makes this group zero for p > 0, so all higher direct images vanish and the Leray spectral sequence for epsilon gives the equality H^i(S_etale, F) = H^i(S_Zar, F).
proof_roadmap: Write the higher direct images of the comparison morphism as sheafified etale cohomology.
Identify their stalks with the etale cohomology of the local ring at the point.
Use the vanishing over strictly henselian local rings and the Leray spectral sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies etale and Zariski cohomology for a scheme whose local rings are all strictly henselian (statement lines 14204-14209). The proof (proof lines 14211-14225) computes the stalks of the higher direct images of the comparison morphism as the etale cohomology of the local rings, which vanishes in positive degrees by the strictly henselian hypothesis, so that the Leray spectral sequence degenerates. H2: one stalk computation plus one vanishing input, written out.
